descriptionChirho: A strip of land bordering a body of water, especially the sea, used of coastal regions in geographical descriptions. The noun appears exclusively in construct form (chof) with various prepositions (bare, with beth 'in/at', with lamed 'at/to'). All occurrences across Genesis 49:13, Deuteronomy 1:7, Joshua 9:1, Judges 5:17, Jeremiah 47:7, and Ezekiel 25:16 refer to the same concrete geographical feature, the seashore or coastline. The multilingual evidence is uniform: Arabic sahil, German Kueste/Gestade/Ufer, Korean haebyeon/haean, Hindi tat, Spanish costa.
